card.name: Right before the word incidence
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'incidence' or 'incidentally' (e.g. 'increased', 'very low', 'their', 'identified'), mostly in drug-label warnings about how often a side effect occurs.

modes.label: Before 'incidence'
modes.description: A modifier or possessive that leads straight into the word incidence.
modes.example: BECAUSE OF THE VERY<< LOW>> INCIDENCE OF AGRANUL

modes.label: Increased + incidence/risk
modes.description: The ending of 'increase' or 'increased' in all-caps warnings, ahead of incidence or risk.
modes.example: EXCEEDING THE RECOMMENDED DOSAGE MAY RESULT IN AN INCREASE<<D>> INCIDENCE OF SIDE EFFECTS.

modes.label: Before 'incidentally'
modes.example: fundic gland polyps were<< identified>> incidentally on endoscopy.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce words beginning with 'inc', such as incidence.
card.plain: It spots places in a label where the next word is likely to be 'incidence' or 'incidentally'.
